# runtime/vendor

Tracked third-party files the runtime copies into compositions (previously pulled from gitignored `out/` demos).

- `gsap/gsap.min.js` — GSAP 3.15.0, GreenSock standard license (https://gsap.com/standard-license).
- `fonts/` — Anton, Inter, Cormorant Garamond (SIL OFL 1.1, via @fontsource); JetBrains Mono (SIL OFL 1.1).
- `hairline/` — hairline iso geometry (see its LICENSE).
